name: Wavelength
tagline: A hiring flow that matches candidates to company values through an AI-led video interview.
problem: Applications reduce people to checklists and miss fit with the organization.
solution: Builds a profile from a resume or LinkedIn, enriches it from the web, runs a live interview with a voice model, and scores the recorded interview with video understanding.
demo_moment: Team-described: apply with a link and complete a short AI interview.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Vultr” among 160 submissions.
Ran the full pipeline on the sponsor's cloud.

lessons: Infrastructure prizes reward a complete deployed flow on their platform.
